question: How do I reset my password?
answer: Open Settings → Security and click "Reset password". You'll get an email with a one-time link within a minute. Links expire after 15 minutes.

question: Where can I download my invoice?
answer: Invoices live under Billing → History. Click any row to open the PDF, or use the "Download all" button to grab a zip of the last 12 months.

question: How do I add a teammate?
answer: Go to Settings → Team and click "Invite member". Pick their role (Owner, Editor, Viewer) and send the invite. They'll get an email with a sign-up link.

question: Can I change my plan mid-month?
answer: Yes. Open Billing → Plan and pick a new tier. Upgrades are pro-rated immediately. Downgrades take effect at the end of the current cycle.

question: Why am I getting a 401 from the API?
answer: 401 means the API key is missing, malformed, or revoked. Check Settings → API Keys to confirm the key is active and copy the latest value. If it's still failing, regenerate.

question: How do I export my data?
answer: Open Settings → Export and click "Request export". You'll receive an email with a download link when the zip is ready, usually within 5 minutes for small accounts.

question: The dashboard isn't loading. What should I check?
answer: First refresh the page; intermittent CDN issues sometimes cause a blank screen. If it persists, open status.example.com to confirm there's no incident. Still stuck? Open a support ticket.

question: How do I revoke an API key?
answer: Settings → API Keys → click the row → "Revoke". The key stops working immediately. Generate a replacement in the same view.

question: Can I have two users share the same email?
answer: No. Each account is keyed on a unique email address. To share access, invite the second person as a teammate with their own email.

question: What's the rate limit on the public API?
answer: 60 requests per minute for free accounts, 600/min for Pro, 6000/min for Enterprise. The 429 response includes a Retry-After header.

question: How do I enable two-factor auth?
answer: Settings → Security → "Enable 2FA". Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (1Password, Authy, Google Authenticator). Save the backup codes somewhere safe.

question: Why don't I see the Reports tab?
answer: The Reports tab is only visible to Pro and Enterprise plans. If you've just upgraded, log out and back in to refresh your session permissions.

question: Can I cancel anytime?
answer: Yes. Settings → Billing → "Cancel subscription". Your account stays active until the end of the current billing period; we don't pro-rate the unused portion on cancel.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: Settings → Account → "Delete account". This permanently removes your data within 30 days. Export anything you need first; we can't recover deleted accounts.

question: Is my data encrypted?
answer: Yes. Data at rest is encrypted with AES-256 and data in transit uses TLS 1.3. The full security overview is at example.com/security.

question: How do I change the email on my account?
answer: Settings → Account → "Email address" → enter the new one. You'll get a verification email at the new address; the change applies once you confirm.

question: Can I use single sign-on?
answer: SSO via OIDC and SAML is available on the Enterprise plan. Contact sales to enable it for your workspace.

question: Why didn't my webhook fire?
answer: Check Settings → Webhooks → click the endpoint → "Recent deliveries". Failed deliveries show the response code and body. We retry 4× over 24 hours with exponential backoff.

question: How do I import data from a CSV?
answer: Open the Datasets tab → "Upload" → drag the CSV. The importer maps columns automatically; you can rename fields on the preview screen before confirming.

question: What's included in the free trial?
answer: Free trial is 14 days of the Pro plan: unlimited datasets, 5 active projects, 600 API requests/min. No credit card required to start.
